# Active Population and Edge-State Table

| State | Exact approved treatment |
| --- | --- |
| Complete population | Every stable detector/channel in one exact observation and TolTEC array. |
| Active stratum | `D_h^+={d: beta_d>0 and exact h(d)=h}`. |
| Zero-mass detector | Excluded from active sign matrix, retained as typed complete-population fact, unable to affect frozen map. |
| Zero-total-mass stratum | `not_applicable` to balancing; no ratio evaluated. |
| Positive-mass ambiguous/missing network | Design resolution unavailable. |
| Singleton active stratum | Balance design unavailable for every `tau_h<1`; no exemption or cross-balance. |
| Nonactive sign | Not implied or assigned by the active-domain expectation. |
| Cross-observation/array balance | Prohibited in base v0.1. |
